note: The script asks for the hook text, one name super, two top question texts and the end card, so 4 graphics and the end card. The B-roll has no graphics.

mg.title: Hook question
mg.cue: Hook text on frame 1: “Are you happy?” Already on screen at 0:00. Does not animate on.
mg.use: Start the clip at frame 0045 (fully on) and hold it until 00:03. Top third, white, bold.

mg.title: Name super
mg.cue: Name super at 00:03 for 2 s, lower left above the captions: “Christie Modlin” / Board Member, NIWRC
mg.use: Put it on at 00:03 for 2 s. Move it lower left, above the captions. Type the second line <Board Member, NIWRC> under the name.

mg.title: Question text

text.main: What is the source of your happiness?

mg.cue: Top text at 00:05, 2 s: “What is the source of your happiness?”
mg.use: Put it on at 00:05 and hold 2 s, in the top band. Keep captions on.

mg.title: Question text

text.main: One message to the entire world?

mg.cue: Top text at 00:11, 2 s: “One message to the entire world?”
mg.use: Put it on at 00:11 and hold 2 s, in the top band. Keep captions on.

mg.title: End card
mg.cue: End card: NIWRC logo, white on red #981C20. One line under it: NIWRC × Happy Productions. The logo is here only.
mg.src: NIWRC logo (white) from NIWRC's onboarding brand file, in the brand kit 10 Oct 2026 (endcards/index.json). Client rule: white logo on red.
mg.use: This is the end card. Put it right after the last line and hold it to the end. Music fades out over 1 s.
